en-US.name: Marblehead Lunch
en-US.summary: Hear the school lunch menu for any Marblehead public school.
en-US.description: Ask what's for lunch at Brown, Glover, Village, Veterans Middle, or Marblehead High School, today, tomorrow, or any school day. Menus come from the district's published lunch menus.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Marblehead Lunch what's for lunch at Brown tomorrow
Alexa, ask Marblehead Lunch what's for lunch at Glover today

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Ask: what's for lunch at Brown tomorrow.
